title: Osiris configuration (osiris.json)
description: The configuration of an Osiris agent: .osiris/osiris.json in a workspace, or osiris.json in the user's configuration folder as the default for all workspaces. Everything is optional.

model.description: The model the agent talks to: any OpenAI-compatible API. Missing values fall back to the user's or the built-in default (Mistral).

endpoint.description: The API's base address, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama).

embedding.description: The embedding model of the knowledge base search; changing it reindexes.

apiKey.description: The API key, never in plain text: {{secret:NAME}} (a workspace secret allowed for the endpoint's host) or {{env:NAME}} (an environment variable; only on your own machine).

packages.description: NuGet packages with tools, guards and MCP servers for the agent: the package id and its version, or an object with the version and the package's settings.

oneOf.description: The version, e.g. 1.0.0 (or a NuGet range such as [1.0,2.0) or 1.*).

sources.description: NuGet sources besides nuget.org and k6labs' GitHub Packages: a v3 index address or a local folder. Used on your own machine only; a server's operator configures its sources.

mcp.description: MCP servers reached over HTTP; their tools are offered to the agent as <name>_<tool>.

url.description: The server's endpoint. After the host it may hold {{secret:NAME}}.
